visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black baseball cap and a woman with pinkish-blonde hair sit in a modern living room at night. Multiple bottles of Coca-Cola are arranged on the table in front of them. The man gestures with his hands while speaking enthusiastically. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a festive red Coca-Cola box featuring a polar bear illustration. The lighting is bright, emphasizing the red and gold colors of the packaging. (3) The man holds the red box and begins to unbox it. The woman watches closely, smiling with her eyes. Several bottles of soda remain in the foreground. (4) A white plush polar bear is revealed. It is wearing a red Santa hat and has a snow globe embedded in its stomach area. The woman’s hands are visible as she reacts to the toy. (5) Close-up of the snow globe inside the bear, showing a miniature red Coca-Cola truck, a decorated Christmas tree, and falling white glitter. (6) The man demonstrates how the snow globe can be detached from the plush bear, holding the spherical object close to the camera for a detailed view. (7) The woman holds up a smaller red package labeled 'Coca-Cola Mini Digital Camera.' She smiles at the camera, showing off the product. (8) A zoomed-in shot of the mini camera's packaging, highlighting the product name and a picture of the device. (9) The woman uses a small utility knife to carefully open the camera box. The man sits beside her, observing the process. (10) A close-up reveals a very small, red digital camera shaped like a vintage point-and-shoot, held between the woman's fingers to show its scale. (11) The back of the mini camera is shown, featuring a small LCD screen displaying the Coca-Cola logo upon startup. (12) The man holds the mini camera and points it toward the camera lens as if taking a photo. A subsequent shot shows the camera's screen displaying a low-resolution photo of the couple. (13) A close-up of the side of the red camera reveals a Type-C charging port and a microSD card slot, held against the woman's black shirt. (14) The man holds the camera between his thumb and forefinger, emphasizing its tiny size while talking to the audience. (15) Four bottles of Coca-Cola and the camera box are displayed on the table as a static product shot. (16) The couple holds both the polar bear plush and the mini camera together, smiling at the viewer. Large graphic logos for FamilyMart and 7-Eleven appear on the screen.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One man and one woman are the primary presenters throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Man: Wears a black baseball cap with a blue brim, black t-shirt with 'ALL-STAR' text. Woman: Light brown/pinkish hair, black long-sleeved top, manicured nails with white designs.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A contemporary living room featuring a large grey sofa, a wall-mounted air conditioner, and beige curtains. The lighting is warm and domestic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity, greeting the audience. The background is nearly silent with a faint room tone. (2) A female voice enters with a high-pitched, excited tone, expressing amazement at the object being shown. (3) Sound of rustling cardboard and a soft thud as the red box is handled and opened. The man's voice remains dominant as he explains the pricing. (4) A metallic click and plastic friction sound occur as the woman uses a knife to open a second package. Her voice continues to sound animated and cheerful. (5) The male voice provides a logical comparison of prices, maintaining a conversational and persuasive prosody. Subtle handling noises of the small digital camera are audible.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Item 1 Demonstration -> Item 2 Demonstration -> Comparison -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and review limited-edition Coca-Cola promotional merchandise available at major convenience store chains in Taiwan. The video aims to inform viewers about the cost and quality of these collectibles through a firsthand unboxing experience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Coca-Cola products and promotional items with verbal explanation of how to purchase them at FamilyMart and 7-Eleven.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal delivery style common in social media reviews to maintain viewer engagement during product unboxings.
